description: Docker compose tools - run compose commands (up, down, ps, logs, exec)

config_schema.label: OMNI_DIR root - whitelisted for project_dir / compose_file / env_file when allow_omni_dir is enabled (default /opt/omni, the production compose dir)

Allow OMNI_DIR as an ADDITIONAL compose sandbox root (project_dir / compose_file / env_file). Projects under the omni root are restricted to non-destructive verbs (ps, logs, exec); destructive verbs (up, down, stop, restart, build, run, pull) stay refused there - production container changes happen only via the release pipeline. Default: false (workspace-only).
